description: Read-only. Paginated DAO discovery via the pools subgraph; name search is case-insensitive, ordered by voter count descending. Pass `chainId` (chains with a pools endpoint here: 56; default 56); the reply echoes `indexedChainId`, never another chain's rows. No endpoint for a chain = an error that names the on-chain reads to use instead.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.
